name: Precision and sail process states
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. PHIELDWORKS game asset source atlas. Exactly 3 rows by 4 columns of isolated process-item sprites. Row 1: round precision optical disk in a small four-tab steel carrier, columns blank / accepted polished concentric disk / intact half-processed recoverable reject / broken disk fragments in same carrier. Row 2: square delicate metallic membrane stretched on four corner tabs, columns unfinished wrinkled film / smooth accepted sail panel / visibly flawed intact film / torn accounted scrap. Row 3: folded silver flight sail in a compact ivory shipping frame, columns loose unfinished fold / neat inspected fold / visibly mis-tensioned intact fold / torn scrap inside frame. Lock carrier/frame shape, camera, scale and center across each row. No green checkmarks, red X marks, labels, status glow or invented item quality meters. Style: grounded industrial game art, weathered charcoal steel, ivory ceramic and copper; natural resources use geological materials. Fixed orthographic oblique camera except pipe routes explicitly overhead. Upper-left world lighting. Actual transparent RGBA background with alpha ZERO outside silhouettes; opaque objects. No matte, floor, cast shadows, haze, checkerboard or text. 15% empty margin per cell.
